answer:
The Mortgage note now has a calculator on its App side, and the app check came back clean. I haven't looked at it on screen.

- **Inputs:** Loan, rate and years each have a slider and a typed field, and the results update as you change them.
- **Results:** A large monthly payment sits at the top. Below it are total interest, total paid and a principal-versus-interest bar. A balance-over-time chart and a year-by-year table are one tap away.
- **Starting values:** It reads 3 200 000 kr, 4.1 % and 25 years from your note. Your changes are remembered in the app, but the note's text stays as it was.
- **Amortization:** Your note says "straight, monthly", which I took to mean equal principal each month, so the payment shrinks over time. It starts in that mode and shows the first and last payments. There's also an Annuity toggle for a fixed payment.
